Your eyes are not cameras. Here is why that changes everything.

Kevin Trudeau asks what we can really change, and his answer is only one thing: ourselves. Every time you point a finger at someone, three fingers point back at you.

He says your eyes are projectors, not cameras. What you see is what you project from within. So the world he lives in is paradise, because that is the world he creates.

What are you projecting onto the world today?

#ad #mindset #success #kevintrudeau

Michael Jordan made the most winning shots. He also missed the most.

Kevin Trudeau says people shrug it off because he's Michael Jordan. But Jordan didn't have the highest percentage of winning shots. He just always said, "Give me the ball."

Kevin's point is that the difference was attitude, not a perfect record. A champion keeps asking for the last shot even after missing.

Would you ask for the ball?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

The warden said he was the only one happy to be there.

Kevin Trudeau tells of a day the warden stopped him on the compound. After 35 years in the Bureau of Prisons, he said Kevin was the only inmate who seemed happy.

Kevin's answer was simple. He couldn't change the fact that he was there and couldn't control that, but he could control how he felt.

What situation could you meet with that attitude?

#ad #happiness #mindset #kevintrudeau

Make one decision and everything changes, says Kevin Trudeau.

Asked for his key lessons, Kevin names this one first: make a decision that you're going to do it, period. When you decide like that, he says, everything changes.

He adds that character is following through on that decision long after the excitement and emotion of the moment have passed.

What decision have you been putting off?
